title: Decision Support System (BIT30303)
description: UTHM BIT30303 Decision Support System, all nine chapters: 71 practice questions, a lesson per topic and a 19-set decision lab built from the lecture slides and seven past-year finals — DSS components and types, data and model management, decision makers and styles, Simon's model, decision trees and EMV, interface design, implementation and group support.

lab.label: Decision lab
lab.note: Fill the gaps in summary tables of DSS components, decision styles, Simon's stages, EMV branches and interface elements. Most gaps are dropdowns; a typed gap needs the term spelled as the slides write it, because a differently worded but equivalent answer may not be recognized.
